description:
How many adults care, unpaid, for a person with a disability, illness or old age, look after children, and do housework (by hours a week), for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 10,500 suburbs and localities and 545 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few people or homes for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/unpaid-work-and-care`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_aged_15_plus, unpaid_carers_count, unpaid_carers_pct, no_unpaid_assistance_count, no_unpaid_assistance_pct, unpaid_assistance_not_stated_count, unpaid_assistance_not_stated_pct, cared_for_children_count, cared_for_children_pct, cared_for_own_children_only_count, cared_for_own_children_only_pct, cared_for_other_children_only_count, cared_for_other_children_only_pct, cared_for_own_and_other_children_count, cared_for_own_and_other_children_pct, no_child_care_count, no_child_care_pct, child_care_not_stated_count, child_care_not_stated_pct, domestic_work_any_count, domestic_work_any_pct, domestic_work_under_5_hours_count, domestic_work_under_5_hours_pct, domestic_work_5_14_hours_count, domestic_work_5_14_hours_pct, domestic_work_15_29_hours_count, domestic_work_15_29_hours_pct, domestic_work_30_plus_hours_count, domestic_work_30_plus_hours_pct, no_domestic_work_count, no_domestic_work_pct, domestic_work_not_stated_count, domestic_work_not_stated_pct. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
